sources.snippet: Evo 2: Genome modeling and design across all domains of life Evo 2 is a state of the art DNA language model for long context modeling and design. Evo 2 models DNA sequences at single-nucleotide resolution at up to 1 million base pair context length using the StripedHyena 2 architecture. Evo 2 was pretrained using Savanna.
